text:
Maya (People Ops): FYI we've pushed a small but important handbook update for contractor/vendor onboarding. Core change: contractors who receive network credentials now require a Level-2 background check + regional compliance attestation. Please skim the section and RSVP to the ops training if you manage vendors. Link: intra.redwood/handbook#contractors

Jon (Hiring Ops): Clarify rollout timing? Any stop-gaps for people in flight?

Maya (People Ops): Rollout effective 2026-04-06. No retroactive removal of existing access, but all outstanding Level-2 checks must be completed and the vendor record updated in GreenHire by EOD Friday.

Aisha (Security): Level-2 = SSN verification (where allowed) + employment verification + local crim record check. Regions that disallow SSN checks should follow the attestation pathway in the doc. I'll attach a short ops checklist below.

people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: contractor-compliance-training 2026-04-07 10:00 PT. RSVP required.

Jon (Hiring Ops): Ops checklist (summarized): - collect legal name + DOB; - confirm MSA; - start Level-2 via CheckSafe; - use regional attestation if SSN not available; - update GreenHire; - notify manager & security when done.

Rosa (Legal): Note: for EU contractors include the DSGVO consent form with the background package. Maya, can you add a template to the handbook?

Maya (People Ops): Yep adding EU consent template now, will ping when live.

Liam (Eng Manager): Question: what about very short-term event contractors (<7 days)? Do they need Level-2?

Aisha (Security): Short-term event vendors can use time-limited guest creds + supervised access instead of Level-2. Manager must file a Guest Access Rationale in GreenHire and approve.

Liam (Eng Manager): Thanks. I'll triage our upcoming event list and chase open checks.

Jon (Hiring Ops): RSVP link: meet.redwood/rooms/contractor-training-0407. Added to calendar for ops + security + managers. Mark attending if you plan to join.

Maya (People Ops): I'll do a short Q&A covering edge cases (interns, contractors on client payroll, international rules). Drop pre-questions here and I'll collect them.

Liam (Eng Manager): Pre-question: contractors paid directly by clients who need access — what's the standard?

Rosa (Legal): Typically we accept client attestation plus a clause in the MSA. Bring specifics to Q&A and we can propose a handbook wording update.

Jon (Hiring Ops): Action items recap: Hiring Ops to finish outstanding checks + update GreenHire by Fri (Jon/team); People Ops to add EU consent template and handbook snippet (Maya); Security to draft guest access SOP for <7 day cases (Aisha); Legal to review client-attestation MSA language (Rosa).

Maya (People Ops): Thanks team. I'll follow up post-training with a digest, a tracker sheet, and a completion report. :thumbsup:

people-ops-bot: Thread pinned to #people-ops for 7 days.
